issues.description: Attribute 'orders' in SealSaloon: the problem statement explicitly requires a modifiable List<Meal> named 'orders' but the provided codebase (solution) declares orders as a Meal[] array and the template includes ArrayHelpers (array utilities) that imply array-based implementations. This mismatch between the specified type (List<Meal>) and the actual/expected implementation (Meal[]) will confuse students about which collection type to implement and which utilities (ArrayHelpers vs java.util.List) to use.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the specification and starter code consistent. Either: (A) Update the problem statement and UML to require an array-based orders field (Meal[] orders) and explicitly mention using ArrayHelpers to manage the array, adjusting examples and getter signatures accordingly; or (B) update the template and solution to use java.util.List<Meal> (e.g., ArrayList) for 'orders', remove or adapt ArrayHelpers usage, and update the problem statement and UML to reference List<Meal>. Ensure all examples, method signatures, and getters match the chosen collection type.
